independence: Independent from acceptance outcomes, but not completely blind: the assignment named the candidate root, baseline root, requests, required evidence locations, and the prior frontend probe context. I did not read evaluations/acceptance.json, audit conclusions, or builder scripts.

environment.tool_call_count: not available as a reliable evaluator metric

trials.request: Rename one local variable in a TSX component.

baseline.action: Renamed fixture-local total to visibleTotal without changing the rendered expression.

trials.check: node cases.mjs asserts new binding and rejects const total.

trials.request: Design a discriminated union for a lifecycle state.

baseline.action: Produced idle/running/failed/complete variants with state-specific payloads.

candidate.action: Routed to domain-modeling mode and produced the same union boundary.

trials.check: node cases.mjs asserts the failed discriminant carries a message.

trials.request: Plan a feature; do not implement yet.

baseline.action: Created a non-implementation plan outline; its documented final GitHub-issue step was not run because external mutation was disallowed.
baseline.material_limit: The closest baseline skill is refactor-specific and prescribes issue creation, so it is a poor semantic match for a generic plan-only request.

candidate.action: Mapped acceptance criteria to boundaries and focused checks; stopped before implementation.

trials.check: No implementation artifact was added for this request.
unnecessary_loads: Baseline workflow's GitHub issue publication step is unnecessary and unauthorized for this local plan-only trial.

trials.request: Implement a small feature from supplied acceptance criteria.

baseline.action: Implemented normalizeLabel for trim and blank rejection with direct behavior assertions.

candidate.action: Implemented the same narrow public behavior and ran the direct fixture assertions.

trials.check: node cases.mjs checks trimmed success and blank-input rejection.

trials.request: Verify a new endpoint returns required JSON schema.

baseline.action: Checked status and exact JSON object from the endpoint fixture.

candidate.action: Routed to API-contract mode and checked the exact public response object.

trials.request: Show a retry fix prevents the old crash.

baseline.action: Used a reproducer that fails once, then succeeds on the sole retry.

candidate.action: Used the same reproducer before validating retry-once behavior.

trials.check: node cases.mjs verifies return 'ok' and attempts === 2.

trials.request: Helper exits zero but emits error object; did it work?

baseline.action: Classified the error envelope as an application failure despite process exit 0.

candidate.action: Classified it as failure; exit code alone was insufficient evidence.

trials.check: node cases.mjs asserts helperSucceeded(...) is false for stdout.error.

baseline.action: Reviewed the retry diff read-only; found no defect in the one-retry behavior represented by the fixture.

candidate.action: Applied defect-first, read-only review; found no actionable defect in the isolated diff.

unnecessary_loads: No full-repository inventory was appropriate because the target was an isolated diff fixture.

routing.check: Node check confirmed both intended mode names in route-fixtures.md.

catalog.method: Extracted only name and description frontmatter from every candidate skills/*/SKILL.md before routing.

results.task_5: Endpoint fixture returns 200 and validates boolean ok plus string version fields.

manual_tool_count_this_retest.note: Count includes the failed first patch attempt and all report/fixture patches through retest completion; it excludes every initial evaluation and frontend-probe call. Token usage remains unavailable.

No shell script or Kubernetes manifest was created or applied; their candidate-only case remains routing evidence.
